about_the_game:
"Kingdom Defender" is a strategic game that combines card-based tower defense with light rogue elements. Players take on the role of an exiled prince fighting to reclaim his homeland from the demon king's corruption. By spending gold to draw cards, you can summon unique soldier units—from resilient infantry to precise archers—to build your own battlefield army.

Each battle is a new journey! Randomly generated level paths and encounters ensure every adventure is full of surprises. You can evolve low-tier soldiers into powerful ultimate units, such as Paladins, Arcane Cannons, or Dragonkin, by merging them, allowing for flexible阵容 adjustments to counter the demon king's evil forces.

As the campaign progresses, unlock permanent upgrades to strengthen your deck and devise unique tactics. Throughout the journey to reclaim lost territories, experience the prince's growth from an exile to a leader and witness the epic chapter of hope rekindled among the people. Ready to retake the throne and fight for the light?
